_comment: What each role may see. Enforced in the service (retrieval, facts, and the event stream), not in the prompt. Unknown staff get default_role. Change a role here; nobody edits code for it.

_capabilities.style: simple = always the plain-English answer; auto = the intent router decides (technical for code questions)
_capabilities.code_names: class, method, model, job names may appear; false removes every code node from facts and events
_capabilities.endpoints: HTTP routes and call sites may appear even when code_names is false
_capabilities.paths: file paths and line numbers may appear; false strips them from facts, claims, evidence and prose
_capabilities.code_source: the planner may read and grep source; false removes those steps entirely
_capabilities.refs: branches the role may ask about; "*" = all indexed refs
_capabilities.admin: may change roles with src/users.mjs (informational; the CLI runs on the server)
